intro: Between April 12 and 30, 2026, ZCyberNews tracked 20 articles under critical-infrastructure, with APT33, CyberAv3ngers, and Interlock among the most frequently cited threat actors. The coverage highlighted CVE-2026-24032 (CVSS 7.3) and focused on the energy, utilities, and manufacturing sectors across the United States, North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region. The reporting included 12 high-severity and 3 critical-severity incidents, alongside three informational and one medium-severity item.
